metadata.title: When you don’t even peek but still steal a kill? Valorant, what kinda sorcery is this?
metadata.description:
Wait, I literally did nothing!
Enemy must be gifting me kills today.
Click if your aim is asleep but the scoreboard lies.
Valorant logic is peak chaos once again.

Tap if your best kill was a total accident!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
